questions.q: What kind of explosion transforms Bruce Banner into the Hulk?
questions.why: Banner designed the gamma bomb and was caught in its blast saving Rick Jones.

questions.q: Which actor played Bruce Banner in 2012's The Avengers?
questions.why: Mark Ruffalo took over the role starting in The Avengers (2012).

questions.q: Which 2008 MCU film starred Edward Norton as Bruce Banner?
questions.why: Edward Norton first played Banner in The Incredible Hulk (2008).

questions.q: What colour was the Hulk's skin in his first issue before Stan Lee changed it?
questions.why: The Hulk was originally drawn grey, and later turned green.

questions.q: Betty Ross's father, the general who hunts the Hulk, goes by what nickname?
questions.why: General Thaddeus 'Thunderbolt' Ross is Betty's father.

questions.q: Which bodybuilder played the green Hulk opposite Bill Bixby in the TV series?
questions.why: Bill Bixby and Lou Ferrigno starred in the 1978 TV series.
Ang Lee directed the 2003 film Hulk, starring Eric Bana.

questions.q: Which hypnotist-turned-ally merged Banner's personalities into Professor Hulk?
questions.why: Doc Samson hypnotizes Banner and the Hulks into the merged Professor Hulk.

questions.q: What is the first name of Bruce Banner's abusive father?
questions.why: Brian Banner regarded his son as a monster and killed Bruce's mother.

questions.q: In 'Planet Hulk,' on which planet does the Hulk crash after the Illuminati exile him?
questions.why: The ship crashes on the planet Sakaar.
